h1: Alta Badia ski resort, stays & events guide
heroText: Alta Badia is a cluster of Ladin villages at the head of the Badia valley - Corvara sits at 1,568 metres - ringed by the Sella massif and the Dolomites that UNESCO lists as World Heritage. The ski area counts 54 lifts and 117 slopes, among the largest in the Dolomiti Superski table, and runs from 4 December 2026 to 4 April 2027.
stayOverview: Corvara is the largest of the villages and the hub of the lift network; La Villa and San Cassiano are quieter, and Colfosco sits highest under the Sella.
hotelIntro: Book against high season. Corvara puts you at the centre of the lift network; the other villages are on it but smaller.
rentalCars: Alta Badia is reached over the Dolomite passes, about an hour and a half from Bolzano.

pistes.note: Groomed nightly by more than 90 machines. Dolomiti Superski counts 117 runs here, and 500 km are reachable on skis from Alta Badia, the Sellaronda included.

baseElevation.note: The operator states the ski area extends from 1,300 to 2,800 m.

longestRun.note: Our pick of the operator's own published run lengths: it calls the Armentarola the true Lagazuoi descent, 7.5 km from the 2,800 m summit down to Sas Dlacia, against 3.5 km for the Lagazuoi slope itself. It does not label either as the area's longest.

dayPass.value: Priced by date in three bands
dayPass.note: Dolomiti Superski prices the day pass by date - early and late-season promo, season, and high season - and publishes the rate only through its own price calculator, with 5% off online two days ahead. Its 2026/27 adult season pass is EUR 990 in advance sale to 24 December and EUR 1,060 after.
